market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $110 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI trading near 06 on May 1, 2026 amid Strait of Hormuz supply disruption. With ~30 days for any 1-min candle to print >=10 and forecasts citing 05-125 range plus continued geopolitical risk premium, ~ upside to 10 is quite plausible. Base-rate volatility supports a meaningful probability above coin-flip.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether Hormuz tensions persist or ease; OPEC+ supply normalization could cap upside.
